'''Munduri''' and [[Sonsigo]] were [[Bravaisian]] podmates who worked together due to their attraction toward glittering gems and metals. Their services also included appraisal of precious stones harvested on newly catalogued worlds, and they would pay top prices for what they sought.<ref name="TFAVD" /> Both were present in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]] when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] arrived with the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. Soon after the groups arrival, many of the establishment's occupants rushed outside to witness the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. The castle itself was soon [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the forces of the First Order.<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> Munduri had [[Color|blue]] skin and sensitive [[eye]]s that required protective [[goggles]] while the Bravaisian was on Takodana.<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is called a snooty pirate. He's a hand puppet, so he works very much in the traditional sense of hand puppetry.|[[Neal Scanlan]] describes the Munduri puppet in the "Crafting Creatures" featurette|<ref name="TFA" />}}
Munduri first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in North America on [[December 18]], [[2015]]. Creature and droid performer [[Damian Farrell]] was responsible for controlling the character, whose costume consisted of a hand puppet that Farrell controlled from beneath the bench Sonsigo was sat on. During the production of the film Munduri and Sonsigo were known as the "snooty pirates" and were not identified in the movie. Their names were instead revealed in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.
